name: anim_hira_walk
subject: a very tall, extremely muscular horse man made of glossy brown paint with messy cream swirls, a spiky dripping brown and cream mane, wide-open eyes and a toothy grin, straight human legs with bare human feet
desc: A confident, swaggering heavy walk: a full walk cycle in place that starts and ends in this exact mid-stride pose, with two clear steps: from this pose the back leg swings forward past the front leg and plants its foot in front while the other leg goes behind, then that leg swings forward again and the pose returns to the start. Clear strides with the feet apart, the legs pass each other only once per step. The opposite arm swings forward with each step, the body bobs 2 or 3 pixels up and down, the mane strands bounce. Same view and same body width as this pose. The body does not move across the frame. The face keeps the same wide-eyed toothy grin. Thick, sticky, viscous paint.
